Name: Nuclear Chickens Mod
Author: BorktheSloth
Description: This mod changes brown chickens to make them look like they were dipped in nuclear waste. It makes the main body green, the top red part purple, the beak red and the feet a light blue. It also changes the babies, but not the eggs because I was unable to find the .xnb file the eggs are in. This may change in future updates.
